newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma has no decision on Tamrock.
newsitem.headline: Rauma has no decision on Tamrock.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Tuesday it had made no decisions on whether to keep or sell its 14 percent holding in mining equipment group Tamrock Oy (previously Oy Tampella Ab) it acquired in May 1996.
"We have no decision on what we are going to do," Rauma CEO Heikki Hakala told a news conference, when asked about Rauma's plans concerning its holding in Tamrock.
But Hakala said its 185 million markka investment in the Tamrock stake last May had been a profitable one as its market value on Tuesday was 277.5 million markka.
"The market value of the shares have risen fairly well ... so they have been a good investment," Hakala said.
At 1255/1055 GMT, Tamrock's share was unchanged at 15.00 markka. Rauma acquired its stake at 10.00 markka per share, Rauma said.
Hakala said Rauma's crushing unit Nordberg is also developing its marketing cooperation with Tamrock as agreed in 1996.
